structure: Retain the primary mixture law and all marginal parameters. Revise only the middle-band copula correlation from 0.20 to 0.137 using the additional CHNS aggregate. Each independent person receives paired continuous measurements; both analyses use this same unweighted cohort.

parameter_provenance.use: Set band probabilities and conditional depletion probabilities, reproducing the supplied threshold-cell probabilities in expectation.
Set conditional Hb supports and population moments. Reported sample SDs are plug-in population SDs.

parameter_provenance.source: CHNS A-only Tables 1–2 and requested cutoff
parameter_provenance.use: Set conditional depletion probabilities and log-ferritin moments through increasing two-slope normal transformations.

parameter_provenance.source: Additional CHNS geometric-mean ratio: 1.215 for Hb 13–<14 versus 12–<13; bootstrap interval 1.061–1.398
parameter_provenance.use: First-order Gaussian-copula calibration gives rho approximately 0.137. The nearly central Hb split implies a log-GM contrast approximately 1.596 times rho times the mean log-ferritin transformation slope, approximately 0.894. This is approximate calibration, not an exact numerical fit.

parameter_provenance.source: Author assumptions, qualitatively informed by Zhu et al., especially Table III
parameter_provenance.use: Retain stronger positive dependence below Hb 12 and weak dependence above Hb 14. Zhu's restricted Hebei population is not pooled with CHNS; its adjusted OR is not used as the requested crude OR.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted crude odds ratio
requested_estimands.definition: Odds of Hb <12 g/dL among women with ferritin <15 µg/L divided by those odds among other women.
requested_estimands.revision_effect: Unchanged: revising within-band dependence preserves all threshold-cell probabilities.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation
requested_estimands.definition: Correlation of ranks of continuous, uncorrected Hb and ferritin across the entire generated cohort.
requested_estimands.model_population_value: Implied by the fixed mixture and copulas; not numerically evaluated.
requested_estimands.revision_effect: The reduced middle-band dependence lowers its within-band contribution.

most_consequential_remaining_assumption: Dependence within the low-Hb band remains weakly identified. Retaining rho=0.60 there, and transporting this dependence to other CHNS-design communities, materially affects Spearman correlation without affecting the population crude OR.
limitations: Evidence-community distributions are assumed transportable to other communities under the same design. Community heterogeneity, clustering and survey weights are not simulated.
Pregnancy and inflammation are not separately modeled; the target includes both regardless of status, and measurements remain uncorrected.
Conditional tail shapes, band boundaries and the ferritin transformation kink are reconstruction assumptions rather than biological discontinuities.
Parameters are fixed plug-in values. Evidence-estimation uncertainty, including the additional ratio's bootstrap uncertainty, is not propagated.
checks_actually_performed: Reviewed the supplied generated-only checks for the previous submission: each threshold-cell fraction differed from A by less than 0.00135, and conditional marginal summaries were close to their targets.
Confirmed the aggregate arithmetic: 1123 women, 330 depleted, and crude OR=(123×710)/(83×207), approximately 5.083.

Analytically verified that changing only the middle-band Gaussian correlation preserves its normal ferritin latent marginal and therefore all targeted conditional marginal summaries and threshold-cell probabilities.
Used a first-order population contrast calculation to revise the middle-band correlation. No new code execution, revised-cohort simulation or exact numerical ratio check was performed.
